title_zh: PR 整改问题—设计回应—证据矩阵
status_note_zh: 本文件登记已形成的整改回应与证据入口；evidence_created 只表示包内证据已形成并通过本地结构复核，不表示评审人已认可或问题已关闭。
status_note_en: This file records formed remediation responses and evidence entry points; evidence_created means package evidence exists and passed local structural checks, not reviewer acceptance or issue closure.

problem.zh: 离线中文 HTML 可能出现方框或 tofu，字体来源、许可和浏览器离线加载状态需要可核验。
problem.en: Offline Chinese HTML may show tofu boxes; font provenance, license, and offline browser loading need verification.

design_response.zh: 采用获许可的 SIL OFL Noto Sans SC 子集并内嵌到离线页面，保留系统字体回退；不嵌入微软雅黑或未清权字体。
design_response.en: Use a licensed SIL OFL Noto Sans SC subset embedded in the offline pages with system-font fallbacks; do not embed Microsoft YaHei or uncleared fonts.

acceptance_evidence.zh: `report/copyright_statement.md` 已登记字体来源、许可与子集哈希；四个 HTML 已内嵌 WOFF2，离线渲染审计确认本地加载且无外部请求；这不等同于 reviewer acceptance。
acceptance_evidence.en: `report/copyright_statement.md` registers font provenance, license, and subset hash; all four HTML files embed the WOFF2 subset, and the offline render audit confirmed local loading with no external requests; this is not reviewer acceptance.

problem.zh: 区域协同只在评审维度中被点名，缺少五个关系对象和八类资源的可审计接口。
problem.en: Regional synergy is named in the review dimension but lacks auditable interfaces for the five relationship objects and eight resource classes.

design_response.zh: 新增区域协同接口矩阵，只写提议交换能力、接口、触发条件和责任边界；所有 partner_commitment=false、human_decision=pending，未知容量为 null。
design_response.en: Add a regional coordination interface matrix containing only proposed exchange capability, interface, trigger conditions, and responsibility boundary; set partner_commitment=false and human_decision=pending throughout, with unknown capacity as null.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 区域协同矩阵已登记关系对象、资源机制、角色白名单、partner_commitment=false 与未承诺容量；结构化证据已形成，内容与合作承诺复核仍待完成。
acceptance_evidence.en: The regional matrix registers relationship objects, resource mechanisms, the role allow-list, partner_commitment=false, and uncommitted capacities; structured evidence is formed, while content and partnership review remain pending.

problem.zh: 缺少一个最小、可复现且明确区分内部序数与真实现场判断的 AI 实验及真实运行日志。
problem.en: A minimal reproducible AI experiment and real run log are missing, including a clear distinction between internal ordinal scores and real site judgment.

design_response.zh: 冻结 seed、输入、候选、硬约束、指标公式和失败标准；实验只分配 S01—S12 至三个场，不改坐标，不把未运行数据写入 simulation.json。
design_response.en: Freeze the seed, inputs, candidates, hard constraints, metric formulas, and failure criteria; assign S01–S12 to the three fields without changing coordinates, and write no unrun data into simulation.json.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 真实离线命令、seed、候选评估、失败拦截、输入输出哈希和 simulation 字段映射均已登记；结果仍只表示离线角色比较，HumanDecision 仍为 pending。
acceptance_evidence.en: The real offline command, seed, candidate evaluations, failure interceptions, input/output hashes, and simulation field mapping are registered; the result remains offline role comparison only, and HumanDecision remains pending.

problem.zh: agent.1—agent.6 的正文响应与可验收证据映射不够集中，运营和生态机制仍需结构化入口。
problem.en: Responses and acceptance-evidence mappings for agent.1–agent.6 are not sufficiently centralized; operation and ecosystem mechanisms need structured entry points.

design_response.zh: 以现有任务覆盖矩阵、正文证据索引和新增场景、区域、RACI、实验入口交叉映射；不新增事实或承诺。
design_response.en: Cross-map the existing task-coverage matrix and narrative evidence index to the new scenario, regional, RACI, and experiment entry points without adding facts or commitments.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 六项任务逐项具有正文、结构化文件或待补证据入口，机器路径可读；本地门禁未被表述为内容评审通过。
acceptance_evidence.en: Each of the six tasks has a narrative, structured-file, or pending-evidence entry readable by path; local gates are not described as content-review acceptance.

problem.zh: S01—S12 尚缺用户、空间状态、数据权利、运营角色、基线、指标、人工闸、退出和风险的统一矩阵。
problem.en: S01–S12 lack a unified matrix for users, space status, data rights, operating roles, baselines, metrics, human gates, exits, and risks.

design_response.zh: 新增统一场景运营矩阵，严格继承 proposal 与 scenario_catalog；S04、S08 明确小月河候选体验/巡检路径仅为非红线概念建议，并保留静态或人工替代。
design_response.en: Add a unified scenario-operations matrix that inherits proposal and scenario_catalog entries; explicitly mark the S04/S08 Xiaoyuehe candidate experience/inspection paths as non-redline concept proposals and retain static or staffed alternatives.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 矩阵已登记稳定的 S01—S12、必需字段、允许角色、fallback 和 human_decision=pending；语义等义与事实边界仍待专业/人工复核。
acceptance_evidence.en: The matrix registers stable S01–S12 IDs, required fields, allowed roles, fallbacks, and human_decision=pending for each item; semantic equivalence and factual boundaries remain subject to professional and human review.

problem.zh: STR-01—STR-08 只有项目表，缺少唯一 A、RACI、资源级别、投诉、验收、回滚、维护和 sunset。
problem.en: STR-01–STR-08 have a project table but lack unique A, RACI, resource level, complaint, acceptance, rollback, maintenance, and sunset fields.

design_response.zh: 新增 STR RACI 矩阵，只使用八个通用角色；每项恰有一个 A、至少一个 R，服务时段为 not_committed、维护为 to_be_authorized，禁止 L3 rollout 承诺。
design_response.en: Add an STR RACI matrix using only the eight generic roles; each item has exactly one A and at least one R, service windows are not_committed, maintenance is to_be_authorized, and L3 rollout commitments are prohibited.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 矩阵已登记 STR 数量、唯一 A、至少一个 R、角色白名单、资源级别、年度活动字段和禁用 L3；运营权责仍待授权。
acceptance_evidence.en: The matrix registers the STR count, unique A, at least one R, role allow-list, resource levels, annual-program fields, and prohibited L3; operational authority remains to be authorized.

problem.zh: 正文四阶段与 phasing.geojson 的空间化边界和非空间化阶段说明尚未形成结构化一致入口。
problem.en: The four narrative stages and phasing.geojson lack a structured consistent entry for spatialized boundaries and non-spatially-mapped stages.

design_response.zh: 把仅有诚实临时空间依据的可逆试验讨论范围作为空间化特征；其余阶段标记 not_spatially_mapped，并写明缺少官方边界、工程或运营依据。
design_response.en: Treat only the reversible pilot discussion area with an honest provisional spatial basis as spatialized; mark other stages not_spatially_mapped with reasons for missing official boundary, engineering, or operating evidence.

acceptance_evidence.zh: GeoJSON 特征与阶段 registry 一一对应，空间化状态、原因、来源和 provisional 标记可机器读取；不伪造官方 polygon。
acceptance_evidence.en: GeoJSON features map one-to-one to the stage registry, with machine-readable spatial status, reasons, provenance, and provisional marking; no official polygon is fabricated.

problem.zh: Sentinel-2 影像、低置信锚点、时间、坐标和许可边界没有形成面向公开包的来源台账。
problem.en: The Sentinel-2 imagery, low-confidence anchors, time, coordinates, and license boundary are not yet organized as a public-package source ledger.

design_response.zh: 登记 Sentinel-2 L2A TCI 的来源、时间、原始分辨率、许可与用途限制，并把锚点标为低置信概念参考；不把影像或锚点当测绘、红线或现状证据。
design_response.en: Register the Sentinel-2 L2A TCI provenance, time, native resolution, license, and use limits, and mark anchors as low-confidence conceptual references; do not treat imagery or anchors as survey, redline, or existing-condition evidence.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 影像项目、获取时间、用途限制、许可 URL、锚点置信度和不用于测绘的声明已由 sources/assumptions 交叉登记；高清拼图不进入公开包。
acceptance_evidence.en: The imagery item, acquisition time, use limits, license URL, anchor confidence, and non-survey statement are cross-registered in sources/assumptions; the high-resolution mosaic is excluded from the public package.

problem.zh: 低置信空间指标的人类可读精度、manifest 注册、机器 data-value 与中英页面一致性需要统一。
problem.en: Human-readable precision for low-confidence spatial metrics, manifest registration, machine data-value values, and Chinese/English page consistency need alignment.

design_response.zh: 保留 JSON 与 HTML data-value 的精确机器值；人类可读层舍入低置信面积、比例和坐标，并同步 manifest、双语正文、HTML、PDF 和图件。
design_response.en: Keep exact machine values in JSON and HTML data-value attributes; round low-confidence areas, ratios, and coordinates in the human-readable layer, and synchronize manifest, bilingual narrative, HTML, PDFs, and figures.

acceptance_evidence.zh: 三项正式核心指标已由几何复算并与 data-value 一致；manifest 与新增资产登记已形成，双语等义、离线加载和 PDF/图件一致性通过本地门禁，reviewer acceptance 仍 pending。
acceptance_evidence.en: The three formal core metrics are geometry-recomputed and match the data-value declarations; the manifest and new-asset registration are formed, while bilingual equivalence, offline loading, and PDF/figure consistency pass local gates; reviewer acceptance remains pending.
